## Music Studio in 0.24.9

**Save song** in Local Radio or its mini-player adds the on-air recording to the top of **Create Song → Your songs**. It uses the original verified audio. The playlist opens on your own songs and saved radio tracks. Choose **Recent radio** to revisit or save another recent recording.

Local Radio rotates eligible unsaved recordings out after 12 tracks, seven days, or 1 GiB of recorded audio per workspace. Saved songs, standalone Create Song recordings and active playback are protected. New station tracks have a three-minute minimum. Playback advances to the next verified song if a track fails or is interrupted.

Both Create Song and Local Radio now use the direct turbo renderer. Eligible CUDA systems with the installed local 2B lyric model write automatic lyrics on the CPU while the GPU loads the music model. Explicit model choices, supplied lyrics, instrumental generation, vocal verification and branded-video export are supported.

## Measured on Windows

Test PC with a Ryzen 9 5900X and RTX 3060 12 GB. Each comparison used the same three-minute vocal prompt and existing local models. Times below run from job start through verification.

| Task | 0.24.8 | Optimized build |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Create Song, automatic vocals and branded video | 203.64 s | 69.79 s |
| Local Radio, automatic vocals | 193.47 s | 59.01 s, 49.66 s, 73.40 s |

Three distinct radio recordings began playing automatically across two natural transitions. The first became audible 60.5 seconds after Play. The GPU peaked at 99% during sampled render phases. A one-minute Create Song recording with supplied lyrics and video completed in 34.99 seconds. A 30-second instrumental completed in 28.38 seconds. An earlier 30-second supplied-lyrics take failed vocal coverage and was correctly withheld.
